# Houston

> A small self-hosted deploy orchestrator. An app is one Docker Compose file with an `x-houston` block. One CLI (`houston`) works locally and against the server. A web admin, Mission Control, handles Cloudflare (a tunnel, DNS), secrets, push-to-deploy, backups, zero-downtime restores and maintenance pages. It knows no frameworks: anything that builds a Docker image deploys the same way. MIT licensed.

## Docs
- [Setting up an app with Houston, for agents](https://github.com/scttymn/houston/blob/main/docs/agents.md): the order of work, the checks at each step, where to stop for the human, and pitfalls from real migrations
- [README](https://github.com/scttymn/houston/blob/main/README.md): installing the server and the CLI, setting up a project, day to day, backups and restores
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/scttymn/houston/blob/main/AGENTS.md): for agents working on Houston's own code (building, testing, conventions)

## Releases
- [Releases](https://github.com/scttymn/houston/releases): the CLI for macOS and Linux (arm64, amd64), `install.sh` and `SHA256SUMS`. Images: `ghcr.io/scttymn/houston-mission-control`, `ghcr.io/scttymn/houston-runner`
